import narwhals as nw

# Lazily scan the parquet file with polars backend
lf = nw.scan_parquet("events.parquet", backend="polars")

# Filter rows where status equals "ok"
lf = lf.filter(nw.col("status") == "ok")

# Select only user and duration columns
lf = lf.select("user", "duration")

# Materialize into a concrete in-memory dataframe
df = lf.collect()
